chunks: A man came to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام and said: “O Commander of the Faithful, I have divorced my wife.”
So he said: “Do you have evidence?” He said: “No.”

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.اعْزُبْ: go away; a dismissal after failure to provide proof
key_terms.طَلَّقْتُ: I divorced; a claim of initiating divorce

ai.seo_question: Is a claim of divorce accepted without evidence in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This report presents a legal response from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام regarding a man's claim that he had divorced his wife. The Imam عليه السلام asks for proof, indicating the legal importance of evidence in matters of divorce, and dismisses the claim when no proof is produced.
